name: cc-ide
description: Cross-platform adaptive 3-column tiling IDE for Claude Code (macOS iTerm2 Metal Daemon, native Ghostty 1.3+, SSH OSC 1337, WezTerm, Windows Terminal wt.exe, and tmux) with palette-unified syntect syntax highlighting, Yazi hunk auto-scroll, native subagent/Workflow orchestration, and shared hardware oscilloscope + CONTEXT/COST telemetry.
